items.prompt: Cinematic luxury watch photograph, vertical frame. The watch is EXACTLY the one in the reference photo (same steel case, plain black dial with three silver sub-dials and their numbers, numbered bezel, luminous hands, crown and pushers, brown leather strap with dark stitching), seen from the SAME three-quarter angle, lying flat on a slab of wet polished black slate. Fine water droplets bead on the slate and the crystal, a thin film of water mirrors the watch. Cool silver-blue rim light from behind, deep night-blue background, crisp specular highlights. High-end watch campaign quality. No text, no logo on the dial, no people, no hands.
